composition_subtypes.role: Sort distinct intensity values to enable contiguous interval selection
Find contiguous window of m distinct values maximizing sum of frequencies

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort distinct values, then sliding window to find interval of m values maximizing unchanged elements.
payload.rationale: Sorting orders distinct intensities so a contiguous range corresponds to [l,r]. Sliding window then efficiently finds the optimal m-sized interval to minimize changes.
